summary: DEFER_CARRY_INSTALL_PRESERVE_R2. The frozen source and host snapshots do not prove a current no-interruption carry installation path. Ordinary dual installation fails closed while the microstructure R2 source is active; preserve-bound-data-plane mode explicitly forbids including the carry distribution. A manual carry-only installation would be a partial, unaudited third release lane and is rejected. Deferral preserves the active 14-day R2 evidence chain. Carry capability, forward evidence, economics, PnL and drawdown remain MISSING_PROOF.
